div.p:
PASSES A REQUEST ALONG A CHAIN OF HANDLERS UNTIL ONE OF THEM
HANDLES IT, DECOUPLING THE SENDER FROM WHICH HANDLER ACTS. USED
HERE TO DESCRIBE A FIXED SEQUENCE OF RESPONSE-PIPELINE STEPS THAT
EACH ACT ON AND PASS ALONG THE AGENT'S REPLY.

APPLIES TO: PRESSW/PANTRYPAL_PLAN.D2 —
GUARDRAILS.ALLERGEN_MW AND GUARDRAILS.HEALTH_NOTE EACH ACT ON
THE AGENT'S RESPONSE IN TURN BEFORE IT REACHES API_CHAT.

SD-NOTES/TOOLS/DNS.D2 — A RESOLVER WALKS
ROOT → TLD → AUTHORITATIVE NAMESERVERS, EACH EITHER ANSWERING OR
REFERRING THE QUERY ONWARD.
